description: Calculate an instant order quote for MagSnap photo magnets including item costs, AI 3D cartoon styling surcharge (+R5/ea), gift wrap (+R50), and courier delivery in South Africa. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'calculate_quote' on MagSnap Custom Photo Magnets (magsnap.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_products' or 'create_checkout_link' or 'track_order' for their respective operations). Parameters: single_magnet_count (optional), ai_styled_count (optional), puzzle_set_count (optional), is_gift (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

ai_styled_count.description: Number of magnets with 3D Pixar/cartoon AI style transformation (+R5 surcharge each, R35 total).

is_gift.description: Whether premium gift packaging is requested (+R50 fee). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

puzzle_set_count.description: Number of 9-piece puzzle magnet sets (R270 each). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

single_magnet_count.description: Number of standard custom square photo magnets (R30 each). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].
